observations.description: L0 canonical path references/rubric.json differs from guarded suffix; registry moved to skill-governance-config and old path remains.
Every plugins/ edit is classified P0, so documented P1/P2 paths never execute; path approval differs for string/list and matches unrelated plugin paths.
CI globally bypasses cooldown; local validation counts current approved proposal as previous change and cannot distinguish current approval from earlier operations.

interventions: Use canonical path and registry discovery from actual repo/plugin root; normalize guarded paths including dot segments.
Use explicit file/directory/glob target matching for both approval and cooldown; existing content P2/new skill P1/new plugin manifest P0.
Identify current approved proposal explicitly; exclude only that entry and retain older cooldown; allow only approved incident override; enforce same policy in CI.
